definitions.explanation: How something or someone looks from the outside. Emphasizes the visual impression as perceived by others, often contrasted with the reality or substance underneath.

examples.japanese: {見|み}た{目|め}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{味|あじ}→味：00826_aji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧しも⟦{一致|いっち}しない→一致する：19648_icchisuru⟧。
examples.english: Appearance and taste don't always match.

examples.japanese: {見|み}た{目|め}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦シンプル→シンプル：10943_shinpuru⟧だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{高度|こうど}→高度：00243_koudo⟧な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}われている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧だ。
examples.english: It looks simple, but it is actually a product that uses advanced technology.

notes:
USAGE:
{見|み}た{目|め} literally means "the way something is seen" and is very common in everyday conversation. It frequently appears in contrast structures: {見|み}た{目|め}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{実|じつ}→実：28344_jitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧〜 (it looks like ~ but actually ~).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {見|み}た{目|め}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ (good-looking)
- {見|み}た{目|め}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧ (judge by appearance)
- {見|み}た{目|め}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{騙|だま}される→騙す：02286_damasu⟧ (be deceived by appearances)
- {見|み}た{目|め}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧{若|わか}い (younger than one looks)
- {見|み}た{目|め}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{気|き}にする→気にする：03026_kinisuru⟧ (care about one's appearance)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{外見|がいけん}→外見：12114_gaiken⟧: outward appearance (more formal)
- ⟦{容姿|ようし}→容姿：12293_youshi⟧: physical appearance, looks (specifically about a person's body and face)
- ルックス: looks (loanword, casual, often about attractiveness)
